initrd_path.description: Base path where v86d looks for initial firmware/BIOS images.

log_level.description: Syslog-style log level for the daemon. One of: debug, info, notice, warning, err, crit, alert, emerg.

verbose.description: Enable verbose debug logging. Overrides log_level to debug if true.

v86d_device.description: Path to the character device or netlink interface used by the kernel driver.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for netlink communication with the kernel.

firmware_dir.description: Directory containing BIOS ROM files required for emulation.

preloaded_images.description: List of BIOS image filenames to preload into memory at startup. Leave empty for on-demand loading.
